verdict.rationale: GitLab stores code in Git, an open and portable format. Its REST API, documented with an OpenAPI 3.0 spec, lets you pull data out programmatically, and self-managed install options (Linux package, Docker, self-compile) mean you aren't tied to the hosted service. However, the evidence shows no documented one-step export of all your data (issues, merge requests, CI configs, wikis); full extraction appears to require custom API scripting or a third-party migration service like Relokia. Missing for 10: a documented first-party full data export feature, evidence that non-Git data exports in open formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration of leaving GitLab with complete data.
